$comment: The plant: facts about the restaurant the twin models. Each fact cites ids from sources.json.
name: The French Laundry

diningSeats.note: Post-renovation trade press says 62; Wikipedia and Tasting Table say 60. The model uses 62 as physical capacity.

menusOffered.note: Two nine-course menus daily; both change daily. This twin models one representative Chef's Tasting Menu built from documented courses and the restaurant's signature dishes.

growthVsPrevious.value: 25% larger than the old U-shaped kitchen

concept.value: Open plan, one flowing work area; low walls keep stations in sight of each other; two Bonnet island suites anchor the room, one savory and one pastry/garde manger.

ceiling.value: Curved, skylit, ventilated GFRG ceiling replaces conventional hoods; ~20 ft at the peak, 9 ft over the cooking suites.

floor.value: Terrazzo, with stainless equipment that appears to float above it

surfaces.value: White antimicrobial Cosentino walls and counters

glazing.value: Fritted ribbon window with layered swooping curves wrapping the garden-facing corner; guests in the courtyard can look in.

lighting.value: LED, colour temperature tuned so food reads the same as in the dining room

refrigerationStrategy.value: No walk-in coolers; reach-ins throughout, including custom 102-inch-tall units

energy.value: Geothermal wells for refrigeration, heating and cooling; PV on the annex roof covers up to half of demand

garden.value: Culinary garden across the street supplies about 30% of the vegetables

kitchenDuringService.note: Not published. A reviewer counted 'at least a dozen' in the kitchen during service; the brigade in resources.json adds up to 15 including two dishwashers.
